steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish the fundamental structure of the app-meta configuration, defining App Name as 'Metallic Card Generator' and Package Name as 'com.metalliccardgenerator.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with precise compilation settings targeting Android SDK 34, using JDK 17 with source compatibility targeted to Java 8.

steps.title: Establish Manifest Permissions and Actions
steps.description: Formulate the AndroidManifest.xml structure utilizing the standard Android schema namespace. Register the main activity and declare intent configurations.

steps.title: Design Interactive User Interface
steps.description: Build dynamic XML layout to capture interactive user inputs for Shop Name, Phone Number, and premium metallic style presets alongside the main interactive 3D card display.

steps.title: Initialize Custom View and Setup 3D Projection Engine
steps.description: Construct the custom view foundation in MainActivity.java, instantiating the Android Graphics Camera and Matrix utilities to process premium 3D spatial orientation coordinates.

steps.title: Implement Touch Interaction Engine
steps.description: Implement raw touch logic on the custom view to compute X/Y delta shifts, mapping tactile drag gestures to pitch and yaw axes for the 3D rotating card surface.

steps.title: Establish Specular Shaders and Reflection Matrix
steps.description: Create dynamic LinearGradient shaders designed to shift orientation based on physical card inclination. This simulates real-time metallic light reflections across the surface.

steps.title: Design Luxury Card Ornamentation and Textures
steps.description: Incorporate premium details onto the canvas: geometric gold boundaries, stylized microchips, luxury watermark details, and double-pass embossed cardholder text shadows.

steps.title: Implement Card Style Selector Presets
steps.description: Integrate interactive selector buttons to instantly transition the virtual card structure between 24K Gold, Premium Platinum, and Polished Obsidian templates.

steps.title: Integrate Text Input Event Dispatchers
steps.description: Develop immediate synchronization logic utilizing TextWatcher dispatchers that immediately render input string updates onto the 3D metallic card layout.

steps.title: Incorporate Auto-Rotation Idle Engine
steps.description: Develop a subtle auto-sway physics engine that automatically activates when idle, enhancing the card's multi-angle metallic depth for the user.

steps.title: Verify Code Cleanliness and Resource Limits
steps.description: Perform comprehensive code cleaning, verifying that no external dependencies or Java 9+ features are used. Ensure layouts render cleanly across device screen densities.

steps.title: Building Metallic Card Generator
steps.description: Consolidate code structure and execute debugging and compilation sequences utilizing Gradle standard tasks.
